scheme.name: ICD-11 MMS
scheme.interim_source: Text read from the findacode.com mirror of ICD-11 MMS v2026-01 because the WHO browser could not be read from the research environment. Long definitions were checked by a model-run comparison, not a byte diff (definition_check). Every code links to its WHO entry. Re-pull from the WHO ICD-API before any release beyond the pilot (todo T-ICD-01).
